profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Our team at Prudential Financial benefits from my expertise in the software engineering process, honed through a Master's degree in Computer Information Systems from Kean University. At Hackensack Meridian Health, I managed and optimized EHSQ data processes within the Cority software environment. 

With a solid foundation from a B.S. in Computer Science at Fordham University, my career trajectory has been characterized by a dedication to leveraging data for enhanced decision-making and operational efficiency.

Today, I work as a full stack developer, with code bases based in React, Typescript, PostgreSQL, and Java. As a software engineer at Prudential, I get to focus on honing in on my coding skills while also gaining valuable experience learning about how the businesss works
